name: Paychex Benefits Administration
summary: Paychex Benefits Administration lets employees compare plans and enroll themselves, and helps admins track eligibility, enrollment forms and benefit changes. Paychex says it connects to hundreds of national and regional carriers and integrates with Paychex Flex payroll. The page lists no prices, only Get a Quote and Request Pricing buttons, and says Paychex Insurance Agency can provide the platform at no additional cost when it helps an employer find benefits.

facts.text: Paychex says admins can stay on top of eligibility tracking, enrollment forms and benefit changes, and that employees can compare plans and enroll without a broker or HR.
Per the vendor's page, the software connects with hundreds of national and regional carriers and integrates with Paychex Flex payroll.
According to the vendor's page, Paychex Insurance Agency can help find a benefits provider and offer the benefits administration platform at no additional cost.
Paychex's page lists built-in ACA and HIPAA compliance support but names no security certifications.
